visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with striking pink eye makeup and red lipstick faces the camera against a neutral grey background. He holds several black-and-transparent lip gloss containers in both hands, smiling and moving them slightly to catch the light. The setting is a brightly lit indoor studio. (2) The view shifts to a close-up of his inner arm, showcasing twelve vertical swatches of varying pink and red lip colors. Numerical labels from #02 to #18 are overlayed beside each swatch. He then holds up a single product tube to the camera. (3) The man applies a dark burgundy-red gloss to his lips using the built-in wand while looking into a mirror off-camera. He demonstrates a 'thin coat' look, then adds more layers for a 'bold' effect. He kisses a clear plastic sheet held in front of his face to demonstrate the transfer-proof quality. (4) He introduces a second shade, a bright, vivid red. He swatches it on the back of his hand, showing the texture, then applies it to his lips in a similar two-step process. He poses confidently, tilting his head and blinking. (5) The screen splits to show side-by-side comparisons of the two main shades applied earlier. He gestures toward the products again, concluding the demonstration with a confident smile and a final look at the camera as text overlays appear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic male voice introduces the new lip gloss collection over an upbeat, medium-tempo electronic pop BGM. The voice is clear and professional, with a friendly, high-arousal tone. Background noise is virtually non-existent, characteristic of a high-quality studio recording. (2) As the speaker describes product features such as high pigmentation and moisturizing properties, the BGM continues with a steady, rhythmic synthesized beat. A subtle digital UI sound effect accompanies the visual transition between hand swatches and facial close-ups. (3) The narrator's tone shifts into a more descriptive instructional style while detailing shade #09. His speech rate is moderate and well-articulated. The BGM remains constant, providing a cheerful and commercial-style atmosphere underneath the primary vocal track. (4) A soft mechanical sound of a tube cap opening is audible, followed by the narration introducing shade #17. The speaker's pitch rises slightly to emphasize the 'sexy' and 'bright' qualities of the color, maintaining a high valence throughout the demonstration. (5) The video concludes with the narrator inviting viewers to the official website. A final whoosh sound effect marks the appearance of the end-screen text. The BGM maintains its tempo until a quick fade-out at the very end of the clip.
